intent: One agent tool invocation as a line in a flight recorder: a mono tool name, a one-line argument summary, a live duration and a status glyph that morphs between queued, running, done and failed. Expanding shows tinted JSON arguments and a truncated result; a failure shows the stderr tail and a Retry. Dark, monochrome, one accent on the running arc only.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries (@container, @sm:)
stack.animation: motion/react for the glyph morph, the disclosure and the chevron; requestAnimationFrame for the live duration

layout.root: @container, full width of its column, border-bottom hairline
layout.header: one full-width button, 10px radius, 12px horizontal padding, gap 12px: index (w-5, hidden below 384px), glyph 16px, tool name, summary (truncated, flex-1), duration (right), chevron 14px
layout.row_padding: 14px vertical comfortable, 8px compact (compact rows grow to a 44px minimum on coarse pointers)
layout.inset: failure block and details panel start at 72px (40px below a 384px container, where the index hides) so content sits under the tool name
layout.failure: 10px radius tinted box, 12px and 14px padding; first row: stderr label, 'last 4 of 6 lines' (the whole count hides below a 448px container and truncates rather than wraps), Retry at the right (28px tall, 8px invisible hit extension; hidden on a controlled call with no onRetry); then the last four stderr lines 10px below, wrapping below a 448px container and scrolling with a right-edge fade above it; while a retry runs the block stays, stderr dims to 45%, the arrow spins and the button reads Retrying at the same width; once the call lands the block holds 480ms so the drawn check registers, then collapses
layout.details: arguments block, then result block, 20px apart, 16px bottom padding
layout.result: six lines at first; full result in a scroll region capped at 184px after Show more; long lines scroll sideways inside the panel
layout.overflow: zero horizontal page overflow; summary truncates; JSON, stderr (448px and up) and result scroll inside their own boxes, fading their right 24px until scrolled to the end, and become focusable labelled regions only when something is hidden
layout.stage: demo card max 640px wide and a fixed 680px tall, centred on the stage; the log body is column-reverse with overflow-y auto so it reads from the bottom, earlier calls scroll off the top under a 32px mask fade and an expanding call grows upward

line_numbers.color: ink at 25%, decorative and aria-hidden (the index is ink at 30%, also aria-hidden)

accent.use: running arc and the tint behind arguments only; light theme uses color-mix(in oklab, accent 70%, #000) for text and the arc
accent.argument_tint: accent at 7% fill with a 16% inset hairline

color.contrast: secondary text is solid, not an alpha of ink: muted (summary, duration, JSON keys, Show more) and faint (micro labels, card header, chevron) both clear WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the surface, hover, error tint and argument tint in both themes

motion.glyph: queued dash (2 2.9) resolves to a solid ring over 300ms; running arc turns once per 1.1s, linear, infinite; stalled arc (past 20s) stops at 55% opacity; check and cross draw with pathLength over 360ms after an 80ms delay
motion.duration: live counter updates every frame while running; 480ms under a second, then 1.52s
motion.disclosure: height 0 to auto with opacity over 320ms on [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]; collapses over 200ms on [0.4, 0, 1, 1]
motion.reduced_motion: disclosure becomes a 150ms opacity fade; the arc stops turning; the counter still updates
motion.no: no bounce, no idle loop except the running arc, no glass or glow
motion.entrance: first view: card, header and each line rise 10px out of a 6px blur, 60ms apart, 560ms on [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]
motion.press: header row press: ink at 5% and scale 0.995; Retry press scale 0.97

rules: below a 384px container the index hides and the summary takes the space
compact density fits a dense log at 320px
stage column max 640px with 16px side padding on small screens

accessibility: header is a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the details panel
accessible name includes the status word (Queued, Running, Still running, Done, Failed) in visually hidden text
status glyph, index and line numbers are aria-hidden
one visually hidden aria-live=polite region per call announces transitions only ('read_file done in 1.52s', 'bash failed'), never the state it mounts in
failure block is a labelled group ('bash error output'), not an alert, so a historical failure is not announced on load
Retry and Show more are native buttons with a 2px focus-visible ring, offset 2px, ink colour; Show more extends its hit area to 44px, Retry by 8px on every side
argument, stderr and result blocks become focusable labelled regions only when they scroll, so a keyboard can reach hidden text
every action is a button, so touch works without hover
Retry is disabled with aria-busy while its retry runs; its label swaps to Retrying without changing width

demo_calls: 01 to 09: earlier done calls (git log, docs/billing.md, web.search, read_file, sql.query, rg) that fill the log and scroll off its top
10 bash pnpm test billing: failed with an AssertionError, stderr tail visible, Retry reruns it for 0.65 s and lands done

11 read_file src/billing/invoices.ts (utf8): queued until the visitor moves, keys or scrolls (or 4 s), runs for 1.52 s, lands done, expands to show arguments and a 45-line result; when the Status control forces it failed, its Retry reruns it locally for 0.65 s
content.copy: Mono and factual: tool names, paths and assertion messages. Never invented output when none is given.

avoid: chat bubbles, avatars or any conversational framing
sparkle icons, emoji or decorative icon tiles
a different hue per tool; every tool name is the same ink
a spinner that never resolves; a running call past 20s says so and its arc stops
gradients, glass blur, glow, pills or badges on the row
bounce or overshoot in any motion
the accent anywhere other than the running arc and the argument tint
fake results when none were supplied
a long result that grows the page instead of scrolling inside its region
